title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the booking on which an approval's administration fee is booked
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product the administration fee of an approval is booked only for goods on a booking recorded with cargo type dangerous goods whose status is requested, confirmed or equipment released — the only bookings on which an approval can be granted. For goods on any other booking the fee is 0.00.

## Truth table (booking carrying the goods)
| Cargo type recorded on the booking | Booking status | Administration fee |
|---|---|---|
| dangerous goods | requested, confirmed or equipment released | may be booked |
| dangerous goods | any other status | 0.00 |
| any other cargo type | any status | 0.00 |

Both the cargo type and the status are read from the record of the booking that carries the goods.

## Points of judgement
- *The booking has moved on to gated in — is the administration fee booked with an approval?* No; gated in is not one of the three statuses, and the fee is 0.00.
